title: ATICO _ Chair
description: Atico Chair is a piece of furniture that seamlessly blends functionality and aesthetics in its design. Its structure consists of a base that combines two wooden rings and tubes coated with electrostatic paint, serving both as support and legs.

With a wraparound and comfortable backrest, this chair is ideal for any space. Its design strikes a balance between classic and modern style; the concept behind it is contrast, achieved by combining wood and steel.
The upholstery of this chair has been carefully chosen, using a brown-toned fabric with a robust yet comfortable texture.
